copy.tagline: Three or five minutes, fast chess with the full rules.
copy.description: Castling, en passant, promotion, stalemate and threefold repetition, all of it. Play the bot on three levels, on one device or in an online room; online matches validate moves and the clock on the server.
controls: Tap a piece, then tap one of the highlighted squares.
When a pawn reaches the last rank, pick its promotion in the picker that opens.
The clock runs for the player to move; whoever runs out of time loses.
Use the buttons below to resign or offer a draw.
